subject: Animation
title: Inside Out and the Science of Emotion
description: A micro-lesson that makes Inside Out and the Science of Emotion usable.

hook.text: Pete Docter's daughter was growing up and changing. He wondered what was happening inside her head.

buildup.text: Pixar consulted psychologists to build a model of how emotions interact and memories form in children.

discovery.text: The film's breakthrough was that sadness is not the enemy of joy — it is essential for emotional growth.

twist.text: Therapists began using Inside Out to help children understand and articulate their own feelings.

climax.text: Inside Out earned $857 million and changed how millions of people think about their emotional lives.

punchline.text: A cartoon taught the world that sadness matters.

quiz.question: What was Inside Out's key emotional message?
options: Joy should always dominate other emotions
Sadness is not the enemy of joy but essential for emotional growth
